title: The Fog Surcharge
story: On the floating glass market of Lantern Bay, Quirrowbank the Gilt Weasel has locked a flock of sun-lambs in a cage and priced them for ransom. He loves adding fees almost as much as he loves gold. Mr 6 steps up with a guild token and a very steady face.
question: Quirrowbank's base price for the sun-lambs is 240 gold crowns, and he slaps on a 25% "fog surcharge." Mr 6's guild token then takes 10% off that surcharged total. How many gold crowns does Mr 6 pay?
solution: The surcharge adds 25% of 240 = 60, so the total becomes 240 + 60 = 300 crowns.
The token takes 10% of 300 = 30 crowns off: 300 - 30 = 270.
praise: Taking the percents one at a time was the right plan — the discount just had to come off the NEW total, not the old one.
hint: Add the surcharge first and get a new total; the 10% discount is taken from that new number.
victory: Quirrowbank counted the crowns three times, hunting for a fee he'd forgotten, while Mr 6 strolled off with a parade of sun-lambs glowing behind him like little walking lanterns.
imagePrompt: A sleek gilt-furred weasel merchant with a coin scale and a caged flock of glowing sun-lambs on a floating glass market pier at dusk, a small knight numeral 6 calmly laying down a stack of crowns.
